About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for software engineers to help build safety and oversight mechanisms for our AI systems. As a software engineer on the Safeguards team, you will work to monitor models, prevent misuse, and support user well-being. This role focuses on the data foundations that make that work possible: the pipelines, stores, and governance controls that our detection, evaluation, and review systems are built on, deployed across AWS, GCP, and Azure. You will apply your technical skills to uphold our principles of safety, transparency, and oversight while enforcing our terms of service and acceptable use policies.

The systems you build sit underneath decisions with real consequences for customers and for people affected by model misuse, and much of the data moving through them is sensitive. Correctness, retention discipline, and access control are core engineering requirements here rather than things bolted on afterward. You will also design for portability from the outset, because these systems run in customer-managed and third-party environments you do not fully control.

Key responsibilities

• Build and operate the data platform that powers Safeguards, including ingestion and processing pipelines, warehouses and other data stores, and the schemas and interfaces that detection and review systems depend on
• Keep Safeguards systems running day to day and hold a high operational bar that serves both safety and customers, while reducing the manual effort needed to sustain it
• Own data governance and integrity, including retention and access controls, privacy-preserving handling of sensitive data, lineage, and correctness guarantees that downstream consumers can rely on
• Design systems that run portably across cloud providers, working within the constraints of customer-managed and third-party environments
• Partner with the analysts, investigators, and researchers who rely on this data, and build the internal tooling their work depends on

Minimum qualifications

• Proficiency in Python and SQL
• Experience building and operating data pipelines or data stores in production
• Ability to work across the data stack, including ingestion, storage, and consumption
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to people outside your discipline

Preferred qualifications

• Extensive experience as a software engineer, including significant time on data-intensive systems
• Experience with integrity, spam, fraud, or abuse detection and mitigation
• Experience building trust and safety detection and intervention mechanisms for AI or machine learning systems
• Experience building and operating large-scale distributed data infrastructure
• Experience working across multiple cloud providers, or building infrastructure designed to be provider-agnostic
• Experience meeting data governance requirements in a regulated or high-sensitivity domain
• Experience working closely with operational teams to build custom internal tooling

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

Security Engineers are expected to develop custom solutions to complex security risk problems and apply appropriate technologies while following security engineering best practices. This role requires the ability to foster constructive dialogue and seek resolution when confronted with differing opinions on security risks. Engineers in this role are expected to participate fully in the planning of the AI Security team and constantly seek opportunities for process improvement.

A day in the life
The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

DoorDash’s Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. DoorDash is looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you’ll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
• Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.
• Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.
• Help build out DoorDash’s international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

Lead Backup & Recovery Engineer As a Lead Backup & Recovery Engineer, you will coordinate activities related to the enterprise data protection architecture for on-premises and cloud environments. You will set the technical direction for how the organization protects and recovers its data. You'll define backup policies, recovery objectives, and data lifecycle strategy in agreement with the business, establish the governance framework and standards the estate is held to, and own recoverability assurance. You'll own platform strategy and vendor selection end to end, and lead backup platform migrations including sequencing, risk position, and cutover authority. This is a technical leadership role rather than a day-to-day break-fix role; routine monitoring and first-line remediation sit with the operations team, while you own the architecture, standards, automation strategy, and final technical escalation above it. You'll present findings, risk positions, and program status to senior leadership, IT steering committees, and audit and risk functions, and defend architecture decisions under scrutiny. You'll set the capability development plan for engineers and operators and review the designs the team produces, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype new capability and lead the highest-risk implementation work personally. Duties and Responsibilities: Own the enterprise data protection strategy and architecture across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. Define and maintain backup, retention, recovery, and data lifecycle standards, including RPO/RTO objectives aligned to business requirements. Design and implement resilient, ransomware-resistant backup and recovery solutions using immutable, air-gapped, and isolated recovery capabilities. Establish standard protection patterns for virtual, physical, database, containerized, SaaS, and cloud-native workloads. Lead evaluation, selection, implementation, migration, and lifecycle management of enterprise backup and recovery platforms. Develop disaster recovery architectures, replication strategies, failover/failback processes, and recovery testing programs that support business continuity objectives. Serve as the technical authority during disaster recovery exercises, audits, major incidents, and recovery events. Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Storage, Database, and Application teams to ensure data protection requirements are incorporated into solution designs. Define governance, compliance, and security controls supporting regulatory requirements such as SOX, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and internal security standards. Drive automation initiatives to improve scalability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the backup estate. Lead vendor relationships, product roadmap discussions, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technology recommendations. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, design reviews, and escalation support for backup and recovery engineering teams. Maintain hands-on technical involvement in architecture validation, complex problem solving, platform upgrades, and critical implementations. About this role
The Senior Manager, Technology Procurement is a key member of Coupang's Global Procurement organization and is responsible for leading strategic sourcing and procurement across assigned technology spend categories company-wide.
We are looking for someone with a strong drive for excellence—someone who takes ownership, raises the bar, challenges the status quo, and consistently seeks better outcomes for the business.
This role will partner closely with Finance, Legal, and other business leaders to develop category strategies, lead complex sourcing initiatives and negotiations, optimize technology investments, and build strategic supplier relationships. The successful candidate will combine strong commercial judgment, technology sourcing expertise, analytical capability, and exceptional stakeholder management skills.
What you will do
Develop and execute technology sourcing strategies aligned with Coupang's business priorities and long-term growth objectives.
Lead complex sourcing initiatives including RFPs/RFQs, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, contract renewals, and supplier transitions.
Negotiate with technology suppliers to secure optimal commercial terms, contractual protections, service levels, and overall value.
Serve as a trusted advisor to Engineering, Information Security, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders, providing commercial guidance and market insights.
Drive cost optimization and value creation through competitive sourcing, demand management, license optimization, and supplier negotiations.
Analyze spend, pricing, usage, supplier performance, and market intelligence to identify savings opportunities and improve procurement decisions.
Manage supplier relationships, risk mitigation, commercial governance, and resolution of supplier, contractual, service, and delivery issues.
Lead multiple sourcing projects simultaneously while continuously improving procurement processes, tools, analytics, and operational effectiveness.
Requirements
8+ years of experience
in strategic sourcing, technology procurement, vendor management, or related fields, with a track record of leading complex sourcing initiatives and commercial negotiations.
Strong experience sourcing and negotiating technology products and services
, including enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology services.
Deep understanding of technology commercial and licensing models
, with the ability to evaluate pricing structures, usage, and total cost of ownership to drive value and cost optimization.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills
, with the ability to influence senior leaders and translate complex business requirements into sourcing strategies and recommendations.
Professional fluency in English and Korean
, with demonstrated ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Individuals that are producing at, or close to, sales targets, and have completed all training can expect to earn between $70,000-$120,000. Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity.
